info.title: RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection - JPEG 224x224
info.subtitle: Resized DCIM Images to JPEG of RSNA Knee Abnormaility Detection Competition
info.description:
This dataset contains images resized to 224 × 224 pixels from the original competition dataset, of dimension 570 GB.

Any information about the dataset is here:

[RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/rsna-knee-abnormality-detection/data)

## Preprocessing Pipeline

To reduce the size of the dataset's DCIM images, a pipeline was implemented to resize and compress the images in jpeg format.

The preprocessing pipeline is composed by the following basic steps:

1. Read each DICOM (.dcm) image.
2. Convert the pixel data to an 8-bit (uint8) image.
3. Resize the image to 224 × 224 pixels using OpenCV.

>No additional image preprocessing or augmentation is applied.
